lines: I should get back before the shop falls behind.
Best I return to the salt and smoke before it gets <pulse>too late</pulse>.
There is meat to trim, and it will not wait forever.
I need to check the drying racks and make sure the ties are holding.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to the block before the first customer comes looking.
I still owe someone a fresh wrap before noon.
I can't leave sharp knives sitting idle for too long.
The day's work is waiting for me back at the shop.
Time to make sure nothing useful goes to waste.
I am heading back. A good shop does not close itself.
The smoker needs checking before the next batch turns bitter.
I left salt on the table and do not trust anyone else to measure it.
I have a rack to turn before the heat drops.
The hooks still need cleaning before I lock up.
Someone is waiting on an order I promised this morning.
I should see whether the curing room held its temperature.
There is a cleaver at home with my name and half a day's work beside it.
I need to count the winter cuts before the light goes.
The shop will smell wrong if I leave the smoker alone much longer.
Anyway, the smoker has waited long enough for me.
